title.narrative: 4. Number of significant bills and resolutions introduced in Parliament have been scrutinized through public hearings and public consultations in various committees

description.narrative: 4. Number of significant bills and resolutions introduced in Parliament have been scrutinized through public hearings and public consultations in various committees

comment.narrative: Based on the Capacity Baseline Assessment conducted in 2020 by the SUBATRA Programme. As per validation workshop with the BTA Parliament held last February 2021 three 3 priority bills have been fully scrutinized in various committees.

Target was established based on the agreement with the Parliament as per workshop on the presentation of the Needs Assessments of the Bangsamoro Parliament conducted in February 2021. For reference see BacktotheOffice Report of the SUBATRA Programme and Capacity Baselines.

In 20202021 20 bills have been scrutinized by the relevant Committees of the BTA Parliament. In 20212022 the BTA Parliament has filed 211 bills and 820 proposed resolutions. As of the reporting date 81 bills and 312 proposed resolutions are actively scrutinized in various Committees of the BTA Parliament.

description.narrative: 2. Status of Bangsamoro Public administration targeted by this action

comment.narrative: Public administration institutions are legally established by Admin Code but not fully operational.
